card.name: Transplant drug label dosing text
card.fires_on: Mixed positions in transplant immunosuppressant labels (THYMOGLOBULIN, mycophenolate, Simulect, NULOJIX): the digit starting a section number or dose, and "of" or "for" after "dosage".
